limitations: This inventory is manual source review, not instrumented statement or branch coverage.
The Linux promo lifecycle uses an injected mock provider; native upload/repair is tested separately with ephemeral RSA.
No live fixed-treasury signer, production RPC, wallet extension, deployment or real encrypted-vault restore is claimed.
Autonomous continuation exists for paid jobs; promo continuation still requires explicit retry/admin reconciliation.
AR balance ceiling does not automatically increase on refill; no reviewed admin replenishment procedure exists.
The legacy Worker cashier/local protocol were read to verify boundaries; they are not approved as alternate production mainnet routes.
